svg.title: Off the clock: freelance AI visual work, writing, and time outdoors
svg.desc: AI visual work: Animation, images, video and posters for clients on Fiverr, Upwork, Freelancer and direct. Blog.me: Software, AI architecture and personal reflections, on a blog I built and publish myself. Trails & tents: Trekking, cycling, camping and nature. Doodling. Metal music.
